integrity: Exact combinatorial rational-rank and GF(5)-extension enumeration verifiers accompany the mathematical proof. The cited geometric facts and Picard presentation are acknowledged prior results. Independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic at least five; excludes degenerate small-characteristic models. The finite-field enumeration tests every class only at q=5; the general result uses geometry and cohomological descent. Absolute publication priority is not established.
title: Zeta functions of all eleven finite-field forms of the Segre cubic
